decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Prior to the first occupation of the development approved under application 00558/A/P25 for the principle of redevelopment of the existing site to create up to 69, 581 square metres of floorspace on the site for a broadcasting facility (use class B1(b)), offices (use class B1(a)) and warehouse/storage uses (use class B8), landscaping, 1125 car parking spaces, access and highway improvements, together with ancillary works, plant and equipment, the details of the access road to the site shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The development shall not be occupied until the access road has been completed in accordance with details which shall first have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Variation of Condition 34 of approval 00558/A/P25 to change the wording of the condition from 'prior  development' to 'prior to occupation'
